instruction: Please help me install the Remote - SSH extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Remote - SSH extension (ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies installation by checking if 'code --list-extensions' output contains the extension ID. Uses existing is_extension_installed metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical shell piping issue: Command array contains pipe '|' operator but shell=false (default), causing pipe to be treated as literal argument instead of shell operator

The command 'code --list-extensions | grep ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh' is specified as an array ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh'] which will NOT execute the pipe correctly without shell=true
Getter function get_vm_command_line (general.py:8-22) uses shell=config.get('shell', False) which defaults to False, causing the pipe operator to fail
The evaluator logic is semantically correct (checking extension installation via code --list-extensions is the right approach), but the implementation has a critical execution flaw
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add 'shell': true to the result config to enable shell pipe interpretation

Alternative: Change command to a single string 'code --list-extensions | grep ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh' with shell=true, or use 'code --list-extensions' without grep and rely on the contain metric to search the full output

Recommended fix: Change result config to: {"type": "vm_command_line", "command": "code --list-extensions", "shell": false} and let the is_extension_installed metric with type='contain' handle the filtering
